EffectArea.description: EffectArea binds an area name and geometry to the script classes that implement its trigger and gameplay effects.

AreaName.description: AreaName identifies the area in mission configuration and diagnostics.

Data.description: Data defines the area's position, dimensions, and effect-specific settings.

PlayerData.description: PlayerData defines optional particles and post-processing applied to players affected by this area.

TriggerType.description: TriggerType selects the script trigger class that detects players inside the area.

Type.description: Type selects the script class that implements the area's gameplay behavior, such as a static contaminated area.

EffectAreaData.description: EffectAreaData defines the area's cylindrical bounds and the particle or timed-effect parameters consumed by its script class.

EffectDuration.description: EffectDuration is how long, in seconds, a recurring effect remains active for area types that implement timed effects.

EffectInterval.description: EffectInterval is the delay, in seconds, between recurring effects for area types that implement timed effects.

InnerPartDist.description:
InnerPartDist controls particle size when filling the area with emitters.
The 1.28 configuration describes this setting as partSize.

NegHeight.description: NegHeight is the distance in meters that the area extends below Pos.

OuterOffset.description: OuterOffset extends visible particles beyond the configured area radius, in meters.

ParticleName.description: ParticleName is the resource path for particles emitted by the area.

Pos.description: Pos is the area's center or anchor in world X/Y/Z coordinates. It does not need to be placed on the terrain surface.

PosHeight.description: PosHeight is the distance in meters that the area extends above Pos.

Radius.description:
Radius is the horizontal radius of the area in meters.
The game skips the area when this value is zero or negative.

EffectAreaFile.description: EffectAreaFile configures static world effect areas and the global safe destinations used by contaminated-area recovery logic.

Areas.description: Areas define the effect volumes, their script behavior, and optional visual effects shown to players.

SafePositions.description:
SafePositions are global X/Z destination candidates used when a player connects inside a contaminated area.
The game selects the nearest point in 2D and derives its Y coordinate from the terrain.

EffectAreaPlayerData.description: EffectAreaPlayerData selects the local visual effects applied to a player while the area behavior considers them affected.

AroundPartName.description: AroundPartName is the particle resource rendered around the player.

PPERequesterType.description: PPERequesterType is the post-processing requester class used for the player's screen effect.

TinyPartName.description: TinyPartName is the particle resource rendered close to the camera.
